_about: Game tests (group game): each is a timedemo of a DOS-GL build of a Quake port, Half-Life or PrBoom-plus (DOS-GL's tools/quake, tools/halflife and tools/doom build them) writing DOSBench H/T lines itself (-dosbench / td_dbtest) and its frame as L<ID>.PPM. game: the key in DOS-GL's tools/quake/games.json, tools/halflife/games.json or tools/doom/games.json (the D: disk); needs: a GL feature DOS-GL must advertise first (mtex: GL_ARB_multitexture, plan Q5); ref: the test whose frame this one is checked against (game-pal-vs-rgba, game-mtex-vs-2pass). Retail data stays in the local fixtures.

Q1LQ1.what: GLQuake timedemo demo1 on LibreQuake (free data)

Q2D1.what: Quake 2 timedemo q2bench1 (base1, recorded by DOS-GL's q2record.sh)
Q2D1.args: +set gl_mode 3 +set s_initsound 0 +set timedemo 1 +set fixedtime 14 +set td_quit 1 +set td_dbtest Q2D1 +demomap q2bench1.dm2

Q2D1M.args: +set gl_mode 3 +set s_initsound 0 +set timedemo 1 +set fixedtime 14 +set td_quit 1 +set gl_ext_multitexture 1 +set td_dbtest Q2D1M +demomap q2bench1.dm2

Q2D1P.args: +set gl_mode 3 +set s_initsound 0 +set timedemo 1 +set fixedtime 14 +set td_quit 1 +set gl_ext_palettedtexture 1 +set td_dbtest Q2D1P +demomap q2bench1.dm2

HLD1.what: Half-Life (WON) timedemo hlbench1: the c0a0 tram ride, world geometry (recorded by DOS-GL's run.sh record)
HLD1.args: -game valve -nosound -width 640 -height 480 +host_framerate 0.02 +gl_vsync 0 +set td_seed 1 +set td_quit 1 +set td_dbtest HLD1 +timedemo hlbench1

HLD2.what: Half-Life (WON) timedemo hlbench2: c1a2, monsters and MP5 fire (recorded by DOS-GL's run.sh record)
HLD2.args: -game valve -nosound -width 640 -height 480 +host_framerate 0.02 +gl_vsync 0 +set td_seed 1 +set td_quit 1 +set td_dbtest HLD2 +timedemo hlbench2

HLD1V.what: Half-Life hlbench1 on Xash3D's VBO path (gl_vbo 1: world lightmaps in the second texture unit, one pass)
HLD1V.args: -game valve -nosound -width 640 -height 480 +host_framerate 0.02 +gl_vbo 1 +gl_vsync 0 +set td_seed 1 +set td_quit 1 +set td_dbtest HLD1V +timedemo hlbench1

HLD2V.what: Half-Life hlbench2 on Xash3D's VBO path (gl_vbo 1)
HLD2V.args: -game valve -nosound -width 640 -height 480 +host_framerate 0.02 +gl_vbo 1 +gl_vsync 0 +set td_seed 1 +set td_quit 1 +set td_dbtest HLD2V +timedemo hlbench2

FW1.what: Fifth Wheel: 3,000 frames of the autopilot touring its generated world, one tick per frame, vsync off (the game writes its own H/T lines, dgk/bench.h)

FWP.what: Fifth Wheel's performance probe: T lines FWP-<tris>-<path>[-tex] and FWP-<tris>-d<draws> (triangles, draw calls, texturing, submission paths)

PBD1.what: PrBoom-plus timedemo: Doom II demo1 (MAP11) on the OpenGL renderer through DOS-GL (the fork's GL compatibility path, screen sky)

PBD1S.what: PrBoom-plus timedemo: Doom II demo1 on the software renderer (8-bit VESA mode: the CPU's work, no GL)

PBD2.what: PrBoom-plus timedemo: The Ultimate Doom demo4 (E4M2) on the OpenGL renderer

PBD2S.what: PrBoom-plus timedemo: The Ultimate Doom demo4 on the software renderer
